theme: Moonlit meadow crochet flowers and bouquet components

patterns.name: Cottage Garden Rose
patterns.construction: A long petal-edged strip is worked flat, spiralled into a full rose bloom and sewn securely at the base.
patterns.summary: A softly layered, rounded rose bloom for the centre of romantic bouquet stems, wreaths and vase arrangements.

patterns.name: Moonlit Peony
patterns.construction: Separate graduated petal rounds and a textured centre are made individually, layered around a base and joined into a generous open bloom.
patterns.summary: A large, many-petalled peony with a softly cupped silhouette, designed as a luxurious bouquet centrepiece.

patterns.name: Dusk Anemone
patterns.construction: A compact textured centre is worked separately, then joined to a single round of broad, gently shaped petals.
patterns.summary: An open six-petalled anemone with a contrasting raised centre for a moonlit meadow bouquet.

patterns.name: Woodland Ranunculus
patterns.construction: Successive close-set petal rounds are worked from a small centre outward to create a cupped, layered bloom.
patterns.summary: A densely layered, cup-shaped ranunculus that adds rounded texture between larger focal flowers.

patterns.name: Meadow Cosmos
patterns.construction: A simple circular centre is worked first, with eight airy petals formed directly around it in one piece.
patterns.summary: A light, open-petalled cosmos bloom suited to delicate sprays, garlands and informal bouquet clusters.

patterns.name: Lavender Sprig
patterns.construction: Small clustered florets are made along a narrow stem, then paired with simple leaves to create a slender upright sprig.
patterns.summary: A tall lavender stem with clustered florets and narrow leaves, made to soften and lengthen bouquet outlines.

patterns.name: Wild Waxflower Spray
patterns.construction: Tiny five-petalled blossoms are worked separately and attached along branching stems for an airy spray.
patterns.summary: A branching spray of petite open flowers for adding fine, starry detail around fuller blooms.

patterns.name: Blush Rosebud
patterns.construction: A small closed bud is shaped in rounds, then finished with a separate pointed calyx joined at its base.
patterns.summary: A compact closed rosebud with a neat leafy calyx, intended for small accents and emerging side stems.

patterns.name: Sage Eucalyptus Branch
patterns.construction: Rounded leaves are worked individually and attached in alternating pairs along a flexible covered branch.
patterns.summary: A long sage-green branch of rounded leaves that frames flowers and gives bouquets a relaxed trailing line.

patterns.name: Maidenhair Fern
patterns.construction: A central spine is worked with repeated fine side leaflets, creating a lacy, fan-like fern frond in one continuous piece.
patterns.summary: A delicate, lacy fern frond for filling negative space and adding a soft woodland texture to arrangements.

patterns.name: Covered Floral Stem
patterns.construction: A narrow crocheted cover is worked around a florist-wire core, with a shaped attachment point for a flower or foliage piece.
patterns.summary: A flexible, covered stem component for mounting individual blooms, buds, foliage and filler sprigs into posies.

patterns.name: Scalloped Bouquet Collar
patterns.construction: A shallow circular lace collar is worked from the centre outward with soft scalloped edging and openings for tying around gathered stems.
patterns.summary: A shallow scalloped crochet collar that gathers and prettily finishes the handles of small everlasting bouquets.

combinations.title: Moonlit Meadow Arrangement Ideas
combinations.intro: Mix the blooms, meadow fillers and foliage into softly gathered arrangements, then secure the individual wired stems with the scalloped bouquet collar.

items.name: Moonlit Garden Posy
notes: A balanced romantic posy with focal blooms clearly framed by foliage and upright lavender.

items.name: Woodland Peony Bouquet
notes: Use the fern as a soft outer halo around the larger peony and rounded ranunculus blooms.

items.name: Twilight Meadow Jar Arrangement
notes: Leave the stems loose in a small vase or jar for an informal wildflower effect.
